scope: Reconcile the already-reviewed source-free SAB control author and current peer route boundaries against exact-profile, container, parser-lineage, geometry-semantic, and native-consumer requirements.

method.kind: Primary-source web review plus local plan cross-check
localInspection: DWG_DXF_3D_SUPPORT_PLAN.md: current 21800 witness/profile, AC1027 ACDS carrier, semantic-reader, and native-consumer gates
DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md: existing ACIS peer lineage, loss, route, and no-new-dependency policy
method.evidenceRule: Primary source documentation and issue reports establish only their stated implementation scope. A generated payload, source-code feature, parser opening, reference closure, transferred record count, or displayed result cannot substitute for independently expected B-rep semantics, container ownership, or native consumer acceptance.

evidence.topic: Current source-free ACIS authoring contract sharpens the existing bounded SAB control candidate
evidence.observed: The current published experimental authoring API describes BoxSpec plus SabEncoder for one immutable axis-aligned metric box under the named Asm23200MetricBox profile; its output begins with ASM BinaryFile4 and contains 86 active entities. A separate analytic B-rep profile covers a limited plane/cylinder/line/circle/ellipse vocabulary but omits pcurves. The crate explicitly limits model validation to reference closure and documents no general ACIS editing or native qualification. This refines, rather than newly discovers, the control-author candidate in the 2026-10-16 review.
doesNotEstablish: compatibility with the currently pinned 21800 profile or the existing ODA-authored AC1027/ACDS tuple
a DWG/DXF container, AcDs owner/key/prototype graph, arbitrary history, or real-world producer behavior
B-rep validity, independent expected semantics, native CAD acceptance, or broad ACIS support
evidence.planUse: Optional scratch-only control author if its exact inner profile is first matched to an existing planned gate. ASM23200MetricBox is not presumed interchangeable with the current 21800 profile. Keep an independently authored analytic manifest and use a distinct exact-profile reader; do not add the crate to the project or commit generated bytes.

evidence.topic: CADMPEG v0.6.1 remains an L1 bare-stream comparator rather than a container or kernel oracle
evidence.observed: The release provides platform artifacts; the project's layered architecture separates container decoding, codecs, IR, validation, and export. Its SAT/SAB reader is for bare streams, declares a bounded L1 profile, and exposes typed-transfer/loss reporting. It does not parse DWG/DXF/AcDs containers or construct kernel solids.
doesNotEstablish: DWG/DXF entity-to-payload association or ACDSDATA/AcDs graph closure
valid complete B-rep semantics from a no-loss or nonempty parse result
native acceptance or family-wide ACIS compatibility
evidence.planUse: Retain only as an optional pinned exact-payload comparator at the existing composed checkpoint. Do not install or run it in ordinary local implementation slices.

evidence.topic: LibreDWG's AcDs source path and the open #1411 report expose an end-to-end association gap, not absence of parser code
evidence.observed: Issue #1411 reports silent R2013+ SAB loss for entities marked as having DataStorage, with a public generated-DXF reproducer and one unavailable customer drawing. Current source contains an R2007+ AcDs section/parser path; NEWS says the store is not fully decoded and mentions brute-force SAB extraction. Thus the peer report is a concrete route-level loss signal but does not show that the repository has no AcDs code or establish a libdxfrw defect.
doesNotEstablish: a pinned current-build reproduction of the report
complete or absent AcDs decoding across versions and object types
the same failure in libdxfrw or a valid semantic solid after conversion
evidence.planUse: Continue exact handle-to-key-to-record/prototype-to-payload closure and readback gates. Do not infer success from section presence or brute-force byte discovery; keep peer observations version/build scoped.

evidence.topic: GDAL's ASM extensibility path is raw DXF carrier inspection only
evidence.observed: GDAL documents raw ASM bytes and a column-major 12-value transform for AC1027+ DXF extensibility mode, while stating that these entities are not translated into OGR geometries. The DXF writer targets AC2004.
doesNotEstablish: ACIS B-rep semantics or modeler geometry in OGR
DWG AcDs association or modern-version writer output
consumer acceptance without fixing block expansion, feature limits, and transform interpretation
evidence.planUse: Optional physical/carrier comparator only, with exact version and block/transform profile captured.
